summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by copying the data limits from the original axis to the twin axis, but it may not cover all edge cases and could introduce behavioral regression.

issues.description: The patch does not address why the data limits are being set to ±inf in the first place. It only copies the data limits, which might not resolve the root cause and could lead to other similar issues.
Copying the data limits directly could potentially break existing behavior where the twin axis is intended to have independent data limits.
